_readme: Individual income tax slabs. Fill ONLY from the Finance Act or the FBR website for the tax year. verified:false means the tool will not compute tax.

2027.detail: News reports say the Finance Act 2026 changed the salaried slabs for tax year 2027, but the official FBR table was not retrieved. Not entered. Slab format: [{"over":0,"up_to":600000,"fixed":0,"rate":0.0}, ...] where tax = fixed + (income - over) x rate.
